name: workflow: pick the offered comparison, not an invented one
description: The workflow's second input is a select whose legal values are two exact strings, 'c2>10' and 'c2<10'. Nothing in the prompt spells either of them, so the only way to supply one is to read the option list off get_workflow_input_template. An agent that sees only a default guesses a plausible expression ('c2 < 10', 'price < 10') and Galaxy takes it literally. This exists because olit's hand-written template projection dropped the options entirely and returned only the default, which the unit tests now pin and this grades end to end. Checked against the value Galaxy recorded for the invocation, not the agent's narration.
inputs: Run the saved workflow that filters table rows by a chosen comparison on the tabular dataset in this history. I want to keep only the rows whose second column is below ten. Tell me what it produced once it is done.
